title: 🔥 THE THIEF ON THE CROSS – SAVED BY FAITH ALONE, NOT WORKS!
paragraphs:
🔥 THE THIEF ON THE CROSS – SAVED BY FAITH ALONE, NOT WORKS!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how was the thief on the cross saved? He had no time for good works, baptism, or religious rituals—yet Jesus told him he would be in paradise! Doesn’t this prove that salvation is by faith alone?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The thief on the cross is one of the greatest examples of God’s grace and the power of faith. He had no time to perform religious duties, yet Jesus assured him of eternal life simply because he believed!

📖 Luke 23:42-43 (KJV)
"And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom. And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise."

🚨 WHAT DOES THIS TEACH US?
✔️ Salvation is a free gift—not something we earn!
✔️ Jesus has the power to save anyone, even at the last moment!
✔️ Good works, baptism, and religious rituals do NOT save—only faith in Christ does!
🔥 RELIGION DEMANDS WORKS—JESUS GIVES GRACE!
💡 QUESTION: Are you trusting in Christ alone for salvation, or are you still trying to earn your way to heaven?
THE THIEF’S LAST-MINUTE FAITH – WHY IT WAS ENOUGH!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how could the thief on the cross be saved without doing any good works? Doesn’t the Bible say faith without works is dead?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many religious people struggle with this truth because they believe salvation requires effort, sacraments, or religious duties. But the thief on the cross had nothing to offer—except FAITH in Jesus!

📖 Romans 4:5 (KJV)
"But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness."

🚨 THE THIEF HAD NO TIME FOR:
❌ Baptism
❌ Church membership
❌ Confession to a priest
❌ Good deeds or religious rituals
🔥 BUT JESUS STILL SAVED HIM—BECAUSE FAITH ALONE IS ENOUGH!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."

✔️ The thief was helpless, just like all of us before salvation!
✔️ He admitted his guilt and recognized Jesus as King! (Luke 23:40-42)
✔️ He put his complete trust in Christ—and that was enough!
🔥 RELIGION ADDS REQUIREMENTS—JESUS SIMPLY SAYS, ‘BELIEVE!’
💡 QUESTION: Are you still trying to "earn" salvation, or have you fully trusted in Christ?
🚀 NEXT: Let’s expose the false religious teachings that deny this powerful truth!
RELIGIOUS LIES THAT DENY THE THIEF’S SALVATION BY FAITH ALONE!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if salvation is by faith alone, why do some churches teach that we need baptism, sacraments, or good works to be saved?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The story of the thief on the cross DESTROYS the lies of false religion because it proves that salvation is a free gift that cannot be earned. But many religious leaders hate this truth because it exposes their system of control!
🚨 HERE ARE THREE MAJOR RELIGIOUS LIES THAT CONTRADICT THE THIEF’S SALVATION!

1️⃣ LIE: "BAPTISM IS REQUIRED FOR SALVATION!"
🔥 False teachers say, "You must be baptized in water to be saved!"

📖 1 Corinthians 1:17 (KJV)
"For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 The thief was never baptized—yet Jesus said he would be in paradise!
👉 Baptism is a symbol of faith, NOT a requirement for salvation.
👉 Paul made it clear that baptism is not part of the Gospel!
🚨 DANGER: Many churches wrongly teach that baptism is necessary for salvation, denying the example of the thief on the cross!

2️⃣ LIE: "YOU MUST CONFESS YOUR SINS TO A PRIEST TO BE FORGIVEN!"
🔥 False teachers say, "You need a priest to forgive your sins!"

📖 1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV)
"For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 The thief had no priest—he went straight to Jesus!
👉 Only Jesus has the power to forgive sins! (Mark 2:7, 1 John 1:9)
👉 No man, pope, or priest can take Jesus' place as our mediator!
🚨 DANGER: The Catholic Church teaches that priests have the power to forgive sins, but this is completely unbiblical!

3️⃣ LIE: "YOU MUST DO GOOD WORKS TO BE SAVED!"
🔥 False teachers say, "You need faith AND works to be saved!"

📖 Titus 3:5 (KJV)
"Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us."

✔️ THE BIBLICAL TRUTH:
👉 The thief had NO time for good works, yet Jesus saved him instantly!
👉 Faith in Christ ALONE brings salvation—not human effort!
👉 Good works come AFTER salvation, NOT before! (Ephesians 2:10)
🚨 DANGER: Many churches teach a works-based salvation that contradicts the Bible and denies the power of grace!
🔥 THE THIEF ON THE CROSS PROVES THAT RELIGION CAN’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN!
💡 QUESTION: Are you trusting in Christ alone, or are you still trying to "earn" your way to heaven?
🚀 NEXT: Let’s issue the final challenge—Will you accept Jesus’ free gift of salvation, or will you continue in religious deception?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU TRUST IN JESUS ALONE OR IN RELIGION?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you know the thief on the cross was saved by faith alone, the question is: Will you trust Jesus alone for salvation, or will you continue following man-made religious traditions?

📖 John 14:6 (KJV)
"Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me."

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Will you put your full faith in Jesus like the thief on the cross?
✔️ Will you reject false teachings that add works, rituals, and sacraments to salvation?
✔️ Will you boldly stand for the true Gospel, even if it means persecution?
🔥 RELIGION SAYS "DO"—JESUS SAYS "DONE!"

📖 John 19:30 (KJV)
"When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished."
💡 QUESTION: Will you rest in Jesus' finished work, or will you keep striving under religion?

🚨 CHOOSE NOW:
❌ Follow a religious system that contradicts the Bible.
✔️ Trust in Jesus ALONE and receive the free gift of salvation!
🔥 RELIGION LEADS TO BONDAGE—JESUS LEADS TO FREEDOM!

⚔️ JOIN THE GOSPEL WARRIORS MOVEMENT!

👍 LIKE & FOLLOW MY PAGE FOR EXCLUSIVE TEACHINGS TO BE A TRUE GOSPEL WARRIOR!

🔥 STEP 6: PRAYER FOR TRUE FAITH IN JESUS!
"Heavenly Father, thank You for revealing the truth about salvation through the thief on the cross. I acknowledge that I am a sinner, and I put my full trust in Jesus Christ alone for my salvation. Help me to reject false teachings and stand firm in Your Word. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!"
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – SALVATION BY FAITH ALONE!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, where is the proof that salvation is by faith alone? Are there biblical and historical sources that confirm this?"
🚨 THE TRUTH: EVERYTHING WE TEACH IS ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE & VERIFIED BY HISTORY!

📖 1 Thessalonians 5:21 (KJV)
"Prove all things; hold fast that which is good."
Below are the Bible verses and historical sources that confirm that salvation is by faith alone, as seen in the thief on the cross!

✅ BIBLICAL PROOF – THE THIEF WAS SAVED BY FAITH ALONE!
📖 Luke 23:42-43 (KJV)
"And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom. And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise."
💡 Lesson: The thief had no time for good works, yet Jesus saved him instantly!

📖 Romans 4:5 (KJV)
"But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness."
💡 Lesson: Faith alone justifies a person before God!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 (KJV)
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast."
💡 Lesson: Salvation is a free gift—NOT something we earn!
🚨 THE TRUTH: The Bible completely rejects the idea that salvation requires sacraments, rituals, or good works!
💡 QUESTION: Will you believe the words of Jesus and Paul, or will you trust in religious traditions?
